es.description: Este portafolio como producto de datos: contenido desde una sola fuente JSON, CI/CD con controles de calidad, CV en PDF generado automáticamente y métricas anónimas con Supabase.

en.description: This portfolio as a data product: content from a single JSON source, CI/CD with quality checks, an automatically generated PDF résumé and anonymous metrics with Supabase.
Automated ELT pipeline for retail sales: Python + dbt + PostgreSQL (Neon), BCB/BCRP exchange rates, data quality tests and daily runs with GitHub Actions.
